notes: All project, detection, time, admission, owner, acknowledgement, fencing and replay values are illustrative design fixtures, not runtime observations. Native shell, Inter, 1600x1040 and existing renderer IR only.

operations_graph.integrate(scenes, base) derives full pins, exact-context evidence readers and read-only setup-diff copies after catalog/configuration assembly. It performs no IO and never changes source bindingSnapshot or execution identities. Parent owns loader, common shell, shared navigation and final verification.

Source basis: round-04/spec/round04-spec.md sections Gate evidence, Pause stop replay and attention; W4-02/03/12/13/14/15; round-04/spec/tools/scene_source.json; round-04/ground/toolchain-gates.md sections 0/1/3/5/6; round-04/ground/existing-capabilities.md sections 1/3/5/6; round-05/ground/t3-ui-baseline.md and current F5 workflow/native-thread scenes.

Optional mise, lefthook and betterleaks were not detected at the accepted source basis. No installer, guessed tool versions, generated hooks, copied vendor templates or live configuration operation is offered. Existing Vite+/AGENTS guidance stays intact. A future chosen change requires its actual reviewed repository diff and separate commit/push/host observation.

The accepted R4 delivery policy is a separate policy study, not a retroactive addition to the existing Review change v1 definition. The v1 digest never changes. Missing optional tooling does not silently become a new launch restriction; missing evidence remains a hold only where an explicitly selected policy requires that evidence.

Capacity control records belong to the separate illustrative env-ws/project-factory/ops-timer-study binding pinned to wf-review-change v1. They do not edit an existing trigger binding or add a run-level launch brake. Three prior admissions belong to window1; an explicit narrowed window2 authorizes at most one new distinct candidate before 17:00 UTC. Historical counts remain retained.

The remote recovery study is a separate invocation inv-f5-ops-remote-01 owned by env-ws/project-factory, with executor env-mac and native thread th-f5-ops-remote-01. It is not a state transition of inv-f5-factory-01 or inv-f5-ci-01. Its source/plan/Work references are linked inputs, not remote thread identity.

AB:65 attention requires owner-qualified source records, coverage/completeness, action routing and source-driven clearing. #65 acknowledgement/fencing and AB:66 replay/control records are proposed, not shipped. Unknown capabilities never produce a green verdict. The coordinator remains an ordinary native thread with no extra authority.

Read-only details use native Back with explicit allowedOrigins. Mutation receipts have no route back to earlier actionable records. Later external acknowledgement is a caption-band history-read, never an app action. Terminal receipts intentionally have no artificial rewind.

Parent checks deferred: JSON loading; integrate ordering; unique scene/region/edge IDs; qualified refs and immutable pins; valid destinations; native Back origins; transitive mutation safety; measured Inter text/geometry; native Figma import and actual-click paths. No builds, renders, tests, lint, formatters or app/external actions were run by this worker.

lines.t: Accepted gate policy and evidence limits
Policy requirements, observed evidence and execution authority stay separate
Before hosted checks or review requests under this policy
Factory-executed exact-candidate local tests AND applicable build must pass. Required evidence is not waivable by a note.
Complete secret-scan coverage and current independent full-required-scope review remain distinct requirements.
A push is not a hosted request. Automatic review subscriptions require their own owner-reviewed configuration.
What a receipt must bind
Owner-qualified subject, exact candidate/tree/range, comparison and target bases, actual command/input and worktree.
Tool/binary provenance, resolved config/lock digests, HEAD before/after, dirty/untracked state and cache provenance.
Started/finished/observed times, exit, complete coverage and raw source. Agent stdout is corroboration, not attestation.
Unknown stays unknown
Zero findings with incomplete scanning is not clean. A skipped/rate-limited/budget-exhausted review is not full coverage.
Keep all same-head attempts and old-head failures. A later listing cannot erase them or certify a different head.
Host-required, workflow-required and advisory are separate. A dismissal needs evidence and current-head reassessment.
Merge-group results do not certify a PR head. Missing required policy or an unavailable enforcing adapter holds the decision.
